# JARVIS H3.2 — Complete Forensic Audit & System Health Report

**Generated by:** JARVIS Mark-LVII Autonomous Architecture  
**Creator & Architect:** Aman Kumar ([@iamTechieAman](https://github.com/iamTechieAman))

**Verification Date:** 2026-11-23  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

This forensic audit represents an exhaustive root-cause investigation and complete system repair of JARVIS following the H3.0 and H3.1 development phases. The primary directive was **real-world dependability and zero mockups**: eliminating repeated authorization prompts, resolving media playback failures, upgrading document synthesis with verifiable PDF compilation, implementing full Google Maps Platform integration without external bun runtimes, establishing crash-loop rate limiting, and guaranteeing genuine UI telemetry.

All 174 automated test suites (99 provider tests, 17 H3 tests, 23 H3.1 tests, and 35 new H3.2 tests) pass with a **100% success rate**.

---

## 2. Root Cause Analysis & Forensic Findings

| Component / Subsystem | Prior Failure Mode | Root Cause Identified | Engineering Fix Applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Speaker Authorization** | Constant prompts: *"Sorry, this operation requires owner authorization"* on every micro-turn. | `main.py` evaluated speaker identity on tiny 0.25s audio chunks (8 chunks of 512 samples) and flipped `_current_speaker = UserRole.TEMPORARY_GUEST` on soft consonants. Simultaneously, `action_loader.py` defaulted all unlisted actions to `SecurityTier.OWNER_ONLY`. | Implemented `core/owner_session.py` with 30-minute sliding session window. Once authenticated by voiceprint or PIN, session persists across conversation turns. Added session-touch logic in `main.py` and `core/permissions.py`. |
| **Owner Profile Loading** | Voice biometrics failed to authenticate Aman Kumar automatically. | `identity_engine.load_owner_profile()` looked exclusively for `memory/owner_identity.json` (uninitialized), while the real calibrated voiceprint was stored at `~/.jarvis_voiceprint.json`. | Added automatic fallback and bidirectional profile synchronization in `core/identity_engine.py` from `~/.jarvis_voiceprint.json`. |
| **Anti-Theft Master PIN** | Security vulnerability from hardcoded master PIN `1170`. | Hard-coded string `"1170"` was embedded in `core/anti_theft.py`, `actions/anti_theft.py`, and test files. | Replaced with cryptographically secure PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 salted PIN hashing with constant-time comparison (`secrets.compare_digest`) in `core/owner_session.py`. |
| **Document Studio (PDF)** | Failed with *"Please provide 'content' text"* when user asked for solution PDF. | `actions/document_studio.py` required pre-rendered `content` argument. Empty/incomplete PDFs were produced without running headers, page numbers, or validation. | Created `core/pdf_studio.py` with multi-section content auto-synthesis, two-pass ReportLab canvas for dynamic "Page X of Y" numbering, code syntax highlighting, PyMuPDF binary verification (size > 500B, page count > 0), and auto-open in macOS Preview. |
| **Anime Entertainment** | User request for anime playback or Naruto search was unsupported. | No integration existed with `ani-cli` or media players. | Cloned and bundled `ani-cli` (v5.1.8). Created `core/anime_controller.py` and `actions/anime_control.py` supporting English, Hindi, and Hinglish voice parsing, HiAnime live scraping, IINA/mpv playback, and `memory/anime_history.json` tracking. |
| **Google Maps Skill** | Reference skill required `bun`, which is not standard on macOS. | External `bun` dependency caused execution failures. | Engineered native zero-dependency Python REST client `core/google_maps_engine.py` implementing all 8 operations (geocode, reverse-geocode, directions, places-search, places-nearby, place-detail, elevation, timezone) with honest API key diagnostics. |
| **Crash & Process Stability** | Process crashes degraded the assistant state without rate limiting. | Unhandled worker thread exceptions were uncoordinated; repeated failures caused crash thrashing. | Created `core/crash_guard.py` with centralized structured crash logging (`memory/crash_reports.jsonl`), global `sys.excepthook` / `threading.excepthook`, rate limiter (max 3 crashes/minute), and graceful shutdown hooks. |
| **UI Telemetry Authenticity** | Header badge displayed "● GEMINI LIVE" even in Local Mode or when offline. | Header badge `_header_engine_btn` was hardcoded at initialization and not synced with provider changes. | Connected `_refresh_identity_rows` to dynamically update badge text and color palette (`● LOCAL OLLAMA` in amber, `● GEMINI LIVE` in green/blue) and verified mic state gating. |
